home.station: NY Tagging System V2.0 • Packing Station
home.chooseWorkflow: Choose the packing workflow for the product being made
home.itemScanDescription: Scan every item serial number into its carton using the ERP Work Order. Standard or detailed label templates.
home.weightPackingDescription: Pack using an electronic scale (RS-232), control weight tolerance, enter PO/LOT, and print Erro labels.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure the printer and sound settings for this scanning station.
settings.local_folder_hint: The base folder on this PC where .btw files are stored.
settings.agent_url_hint: The system automatically scans local ports to find the Agent.
settings.audio_output_hint: Speaker that plays an alert sound when an incorrect scan occurs.
settings.centralized_desc: Commands are sent from the server. BarTender must be installed on the server.
settings.local_desc: Commands are sent to a local agent running on this PC. Best for USB printers.
settings.no_printers_found: No printers found. Ensure the {mode} is running and click 🔄.
settings.printer_list_source: The printer list is fetched from the {mode}.
settings.fallback_template_hint: Absolute path on the server used if product config is missing.
settings.agent_description: The Print Agent runs on this workstation and receives browser print requests through a local port.
settings.template_directory_description: This folder contains seven standard templates. The system looks in it on the {location}.
settings.check_templates_local: Check workstation files through Print Agent
settings.engine_description: BarTender COM integration status. An administrator can restart a stalled bartend.exe process.
settings.engine_admin_only: Engine restart is available to Administrators only.
settings.scale_instruction: Connect the scale through RS-232 / USB-Serial and enable continuous streaming.
settings.scale_tare_instruction: Use the physical scale keypad for tare and zero.
settings.agent_connection_failed: Cannot connect to the workstation Print Agent.
settings.restart_engine_confirm: Restart the BarTender COM Engine? This will stop the current bartend.exe process.
settings.restart_engine_failed: Could not restart BarTender COM Engine.
settings.agent_not_found: No Local Agent found on ports 8080, 8081, or 8082.
